import_modules_from_strings: import Python modules from a list of dotted module name strings with optional failure tolerance
apply_to: recursively apply a transformation function to elements in nested dicts, lists, or tuples matching a predicate
get_object_from_string: dynamically retrieve a class, function, or module object from its fully qualified dotted string name
requires_package: decorate a function to check at runtime that required Python packages are installed before execution
deprecated_function: decorate a function to emit a deprecation warning and update its docstring with removal version info
